notes.title: Steam Next Fest DEMO is HERE!?!
notes.content:
[h2]What have i been doing[/h2]
I've polished and worked hard to make Miglorn as fun as possible. If you've played previous demos, there is some new content, but mostly I've focused on bug fixes, polish, and making the game as clear as possible for new players.

[h2]Thank you so much[/h2]
I hope you all enjoy this new update/demo, and I really appreciate all the support from the Discord members and everyone who has wishlisted the game!

I've also made a new trailer for Miglorn
[previewyoutube=8CZBJZmGuLc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3]NEW[/h3]

[list]
[*] New Ballista upgrade
[*] New UI for statue
[*] New bone resource
[*] New crafting table
[*] New anvil building
[*] New follower job: Gatherer, who will gather berries from bushes (to automate berry gathering and increase the importance of farms)
[*] New bone tools: Bone Axe, Bone Sword, Bone Pickaxe
[*] New Slime Pickaxe tool
[/list]

[h3]CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changes to follower manager
[*] Changes to follower hunger system
[*] Changes to follower priorities
[/list]

[h3]FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed various UI bugs
[*] Fixed wall bugs
[*] Fixed inventory bugs
[*] Other miscellaneous bugs ;)
[/list]

tags.feature: New follower job: Gatherer, who will gather berries from bushes (to automate berry gathering and increase the importance of farms)
New bone tools: Bone Axe, Bone Sword, Bone Pickaxe
